newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Duma council approves budget timetable.
newsitem.headline: Russian Duma council approves budget timetable.

text.p: The agenda-setting council of Russia's State Duma lower house of parliament on Tuesday confirmed the timetable for the passage of the 1997 budget, whcih was adopted at a first reading on Sunday.

Duma budget committee chairman Mikhail Zadornov said one more extraordinary session of the chamber may be required to consider the budget and tax legislation during an unusual fourth reading on December 28.
Dec 17-18 - Working group of Duma committees and government examine expenditure items
Dec 19 - Duma committees examine working group's proposals. Budget committee looks at draft tax laws and prepares them for second reading
Dec 20 - Budget committee summarises other committees' proposals
Dec 21 Duma committees consider proposed amendments to budget draft and prepare recommendations on them
Dec 23 - Budget committee considers recommendations on proposed amendments
Dec 24 - Duma factions and groups examine draft budget
Dec 25 - Duma plenary session considers and votes on budget draft in second and third readings.
Once the Duma has adopted the draft, it is submitted to the upper chamber, the Federation Council. It must finally be signed by President Boris Yeltsin.
December 25 and December 26 are working days in Russia.
